New Year Special Himachal Tour Itinerary
Day 1 - 29th Dec - Departure from Mumbai
Assemble at Mumbai Central as per train departure to Chandigarh or Ambala Cant Jn. Overnight Journey in Train.
Day 2 - 30th Dec - Arrival at Chandigarh
Reach Chandigarh station/ Ambala Cant Jn. by afternoon. Experience local street food (On your own) before heading on to Manali. Proceed for Manali. Overnight journey Enjoy your road trip with your companions.
Day 3 - 31st Dec - Arrival at Manali
Arrive at Manali in Morning. Breakfast on the way to Manali. Check-in at the Hotel. Take a rest for sometime. Full day at leisure or visit Local market (nearby from the hotel). This evening we will have the Dj Night. Enjoy, Dance, play games with your Companions. Dinner and Overnight Stay at Hotel.
Day 4 - 1st Jan - Visit Solang Valley
Have breakfast and depart for snow point: solang valley. Enjoy snow activities at Solang valley. Evening free time for shopping in Local Market or can rest at the hotel. Dinner & overnight stay at the hotel. Music Night in Evening.
Day 5 - 2nd Jan - Manali Sightseeing
Have morning breakfast at the hotel. Later proceed for Manali local sightseeing of Hidimba temple, Vashisth hot spring, club house, Van Vihar ,Tibetan monastery and mall road. Dinner and Overnight stay at hotel. Bonfire In Evening.
Day 6 - 3rd Jan - Manali to Kasol via Kullu
After breakfast check-out from hotel enroute visit Kullu It is known for its adventure activities such as river rafting included in the package and paragliding. Later proceed for Kasol. At arrival in Kasol check-ln to our Campsite. Dinner and overnight stay in camps.
Day 7 - 4th Jan - Kasol to Amritsar
After breakfast check out from camp and have full day local sightseeing of Kasol. Visit Manikaran Gurudwara and Temple for Hot Water Springs. You can also Enjoy the traditional Langar at Manikaran Sahib. Visit kasol Market in evening. Later proceed towards Amritsar. Overnight Journey to Amritsar.
Day 8 - 5th Jan - Amritsar
Early morning in Amritsar. At arrival check in at hotel Later proceed to visit Wagah Border and After that you can visit Golden Temple for night view (walkable distance from hotel). Back to hotel. Dinner and overnight stay at hotel.
Day 9 - 6th Jan - Amritsar Sightseeing
After breakfast check-out from hotel and proceed to visit Golden Temple & Jalian Wala Bagh. Get back to the hotel take your luggage/belongings after that proceed towards Amritsar station to board TEMPLE SPL (12904) at 06:55pm departure to MUMBAI by 11:45pm (next day).
Day 10 - 7th Jan - Arrival at Mumbai
Full day journey in train. Have a memorable train journey with friends. Arrive at Mumbai Central (MMCT) by 11:45 pm at Night.
